result.description: Pay-as-you-go REST APIs for SEO and web data: SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, content analysis, labs, merchant, app data, AI optimization.
result.auth_detail: HTTP Basic auth with API login and an auto-generated API password from the API Access dashboard. No OAuth. Each user creates their own credentials.
result.access_detail: Free signup gives $1 trial credit and a free Sandbox that returns dummy data only. Real data needs a paid balance; minimum top-up is $50, and funds don't expire. There is no app review, partner or ISV gate: each end user creates their own API login and password, so no vendor approval is needed. The only gate is the paid balance (no subscription).
result.api_notes: REST/JSON; supports live and task-based (post/get) modes. Products: SERP, AI Optimization, Keywords Data, DataForSEO Labs, Backlinks, OnPage, Content Analysis, Merchant, App Data, Domain Analytics, Business Data. Hundreds of endpoints.
result.blocker: Live data needs a paid balance (minimum $50 top-up). Free tier is $1 trial credit and a dummy-data Sandbox only. No approval gate.

evidence.quote: Yes. The minimum account top-up is $50.
The Sandbox provides sample responses for testing, while trial credit lets you test paid API functionality.
Add funds to your account and pay for API services as you use them.
Point your MCP-compatible client to the official DataForSEO remote endpoint:
DataForSEO is using the Basic Authentication, which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language
DataForSEO API is using the REST technology for interchanging data between your application and our service.
